purpose: Test discrete XAUUSD psychological round-level reaction and break-retest events as an independent source under the frozen 30-second lifecycle.

source_basis.source: MetaQuotes — How to Detect Round-Number Liquidity in MQL5
source_basis.logic: Gold is explicitly treated as sensitive to whole-number liquidity; example strategy uses round level plus completed-candle rejection timing.

source_basis.source: TradingView open source — Psychological Round Levels
source_basis.logic: Gold defaults to a $10 psychological grid.

source_basis.source: TradingView open source — XAUUSD Psych Zones (0/25/50/75)
source_basis.logic: Gold psychological levels are used as reaction and break/retest locations.

source_basis.source: TradingView open source — Round Numbers Levels
source_basis.logic: Major and mid round levels are treated as distinct reaction references.

configs.C01_TEN_DOLLAR_REJECTION: M1 bar opens on one side of nearest $10 level, trades through/touches it, and closes back on original side; enter rejection direction at close.
configs.C02_FIVE_DOLLAR_REJECTION: Same causal rejection grammar on $5 half-grid levels.
configs.C03_TEN_DOLLAR_BREAK_RETEST: Completed M1 close crosses a $10 level; within next 3 completed M1 bars price retests level and closes on breakout side; enter continuation at retest close.
configs.C04_TEN_DOLLAR_REJECTION_DIRECTIONAL_BOD: As C01, require rejection candle directional body (close>open long / close<open short).
